note: 人工双语交接草稿，待配音，不填时间轴；采样缺失不等同上下文断裂，日志仅保留批准的关联字段。

series.title: 链路断点：队列消费者交接
series.premise: checkout到receipt消费者的追踪不连续。白班已检查网关、采样和消息元数据，晚班接手消费者传播验证。
series.outcome: 确认受控采样请求在生产者有traceparent而消费者创建了无关联根跨度；低采样率另解释部分整条链路缺失。晚班接收脱敏关联日志、测试矩阵、批准的修复候选和次日验收计划，生产修复仍未完成。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.en: the trace breaks at the consumer

phraseDefinitions.zh: 上下文附加字段允许清单

recycling.note: 未来候选不计实际复现；本稿旧引用只来自p001–p350及本文件此前。

dialogues.title: 交接不是宣布修复
dialogues.premise: 白班尚未修复消费者追踪，晚班接收背景。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别追踪中断与业务失败。

lines.en: Okay, the trace breaks at the consumer. Receipt jobs still complete in our checks.
lines.zh: 好，追踪在消费者处断开，检查中的收据任务仍完成。

lines.en: That doesn't prove every job succeeds. Which tracing path and business checks did you cover?
lines.zh: 这不能证明所有任务成功，查了哪些追踪路径和业务检查？

lines.en: We'll hand over the evidence tonight. Just to confirm, repair is still pending, right?
lines.zh: 今晚交接证据，确认一下，修复仍待完成，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, the root cause is still open. It's instrumentation. Sorry, maybe instrumentation, not message delivery.
lines.zh: 是，根因尚未查明。是埋点问题。抱歉，是可能为埋点而非消息投递。

lines.en: Keep an eye on delivery independently. Missing traces can't replace queue health checks.
lines.zh: 独立关注投递，缺失追踪不能代替队列健康检查。

lines.en: Gateway spans reach the store normally. The break appears after the receipt queue.
lines.zh: 网关跨度正常到存储，断点出现在收据队列之后。

lines.en: Show one controlled request end to end. Don't infer propagation from aggregate span counts.
lines.zh: 展示一个受控请求的端到端路径，不由总跨度数推断传播。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for reviewing examples? We have twenty minutes before shift change.
lines.zh: 那么，例子核查预计多久？换班前有二十分钟。

lines.en: Five minutes for the selected examples. Remaining tests need explicit owners tonight.
lines.zh: 选定例子五分钟，剩余测试今晚要明确负责人。

lines.en: I'll describe service coverage next. No customer payloads in the shared handoff notes.
lines.zh: 接着说明服务覆盖，共享交接记录不放客户载荷。

dialogues.title: 只在收据消费者缺关联
dialogues.premise: 网关跨度存在，开始圈定服务和受控请求覆盖。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清范围及不能外推的部分。

lines.en: Trace coverage includes gateway and checkout. Receipt consumers show separate roots for sampled tests.
lines.zh: 追踪覆盖网关和结账，采样测试的收据消费者显示独立根。

lines.en: Are all consumer versions affected? Separate older workers from the current deployment.
lines.zh: 所有消费者版本受影响吗？旧进程与当前部署分开看。

lines.en: Okay, current workers reproduce the break. That's our blast radius in the tested path.
lines.zh: 好，当前进程复现断点，这是已测路径的影响范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we haven't cleared older workers, right? Keep that limitation in view.
lines.zh: 确认一下，旧进程还没排除，对吧？保留这个限制。

lines.en: Good. Can you rule that out as export loss? Root spans still need delivery verification.
lines.zh: 好，能排除导出丢失吗？根跨度仍需验证投递。

lines.en: I'm on it for exporter receipts. Maybe the roots arrived but their parents didn't.
lines.zh: 导出回执我来查，可能根已到而父跨度没到。

lines.en: For our controlled requests, parents are stored. That weakens export loss as this explanation.
lines.zh: 受控请求的父跨度已存储，这削弱了导出丢失的解释。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is lost consumer context. We still need to inspect message metadata.
lines.zh: 当前假设是消费者上下文丢失，仍需检查消息元数据。

lines.en: Check sampling separately first. Unrecorded spans aren't automatically evidence of broken propagation.
lines.zh: 先单独检查采样，未记录跨度不自动证明传播故障。

lines.en: So, Raj will explain both configurations. Don't collapse them into one missing-trace diagnosis.
lines.zh: 那么，Raj说明两种配置，不要混成一个缺追踪诊断。

dialogues.title: 未记录不等于没上下文
dialogues.premise: 已圈定消费者，先检查采样策略与导出证据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分采样标记、传播和记录。

lines.en: The sampling decision starts at checkout. Managed configuration records ten percent at the head.
lines.zh: 采样决策始于结账，统一配置在入口记录百分之十。

lines.en: Low sampling explains some absent traces. It doesn't explain split roots on sampled requests.
lines.zh: 低采样解释部分追踪缺失，但不能解释已采样请求的分裂根。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, context travels even when unrecorded, right? These are separate concerns.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，即使未记录上下文也传递，对吧？这是两件事。

lines.en: Yes, our parent-based policy respects upstream decisions. Maybe a consumer overrides that setting.
lines.zh: 是，基于父上下文策略尊重上游决策，消费者可能覆盖设置。

lines.en: Check effective settings, not just defaults. Export drops can also reduce observed trace coverage.
lines.zh: 查生效设置，不只看默认值，导出丢弃也会降低覆盖。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis stays limited to sampled tests. I'll keep an eye on export failures.
lines.zh: 当前假设限于已采样测试，我关注导出失败。

lines.en: Don't raise global sampling to one hundred percent. That adds cost and sensitive-data exposure.
lines.zh: 不要把全局采样升到百分之百，那会增加成本和敏感数据暴露。

lines.en: So, let's park that global increase. Use approved test traffic with explicit sampling.
lines.zh: 那么，全局增加先放下，用明确采样的批准测试流量。

lines.en: That isolates propagation without changing production volume. Record the test flag and request boundary.
lines.zh: 这样隔离传播而不改变生产量，记录测试标记与请求边界。

lines.en: I'll show the queue metadata next. It contains a trace header, not customer identity.
lines.zh: 接着展示队列元数据，里面是追踪头，不是客户身份。

dialogues.title: 消息里有头还要提取
dialogues.premise: 采样与断点分开，查看已采样请求的消息传播。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别注入与提取是两端责任。

lines.en: We inject headers to propagate context. The consumer must extract them before creating spans.
lines.zh: 我们注入头来传递上下文，消费者必须先提取再创建跨度。

lines.en: Does middleware strip traceparent? Check metadata before and after the queue adapter.
lines.zh: 中间件是否去掉traceparent？检查队列适配器前后的元数据。

lines.en: Okay, let me tail the log safely. Approved field checks show the header survives.
lines.zh: 好，我安全地盯日志，批准字段检查显示头保留下来。

lines.en: Just to confirm, surviving headers don't prove extraction, right? The consumer still needs checking.
lines.zh: 确认一下，头保留不证明已提取，对吧？仍需查消费者。

lines.en: Exactly. Inspect the active context at span creation. Don't dump the entire message payload.
lines.zh: 没错，检查创建跨度时的活动上下文，不转储整份消息载荷。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is extraction happens too late. Maybe the wrapper starts a root first.
lines.zh: 当前假设是提取太晚，包装器可能先启动根跨度。

lines.en: Check source and runtime order together. Managed configuration won't repair incorrect instrumentation order.
lines.zh: 源码与运行时顺序一起查，统一配置修不了错误埋点顺序。

lines.en: I'm on it with one test message. I'll record identifiers, not tokens or addresses.
lines.zh: 我用一条测试消息来查，记录标识符，不记令牌或地址。

lines.en: Limit access to those identifiers too. Correlation data can still reveal customer activity.
lines.zh: 这些标识符也限制访问，关联数据仍可能揭示客户活动。

lines.en: So, evidence goes in restricted notes. Then we'll compare the parent relationships.
lines.zh: 那么，证据放受限记录，然后比较父关联。

dialogues.title: 创建了另一个根
dialogues.premise: 消息保留traceparent，检查消费者创建跨度时的活动上下文。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分明确证据与尚未验证修复。

lines.en: The parent span exists in storage. The consumer span has a different trace identifier.
lines.zh: 父跨度已在存储，消费者跨度有不同追踪标识。

lines.en: Okay, the wrapper creates it before extraction. Our controlled request reproduces that order.
lines.zh: 好，包装器在提取前创建跨度，受控请求复现了顺序。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that's not sampling loss, right? Both traces were actually recorded.
lines.zh: 确认一下，这不是采样丢失，对吧？两条追踪实际都记录了。

lines.en: For this request, yes. You can rule that out here, not for every missing trace.
lines.zh: 对这个请求是的，这里能排除，但不能排除所有缺追踪情况。

lines.en: The earlier note says the root cause is still open. I'll update this tested finding.
lines.zh: 此前记录说根因未明，我会更新这个已测发现。

lines.en: State the exact finding and version. The repair still needs retry and concurrency tests.
lines.zh: 说明准确发现和版本，修复仍需重试与并发测试。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis now has runtime evidence. Maybe extraction should move into the wrapper.
lines.zh: 当前假设有运行时证据，提取可能应移进包装器。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for a reviewed patch? No production change during this handoff.
lines.zh: 那么，评审补丁预计多久？交接期间不改生产。

lines.en: Tomorrow morning if tests pass. Tonight I can validate the proposed order in staging.
lines.zh: 测试通过的话明早，今晚我可在预发布验证提议顺序。

lines.en: I'll document the unresolved tests before leaving. Temporary logs can support tonight's investigation.
lines.zh: 离开前记录未完成测试，临时日志可支持今晚排查。

dialogues.title: 脱敏日志只补关联证据
dialogues.premise: 断点机制已在受控请求中复现，生产修复待评审。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清临时日志不是完整追踪替代。

lines.en: Redacted correlation logs are our temporary workaround. They link approved test messages to worker attempts.
lines.zh: 脱敏关联日志是临时方案，关联批准测试消息与进程尝试。

lines.en: Which fields are permitted? A masked payload can still expose payment or identity details.
lines.zh: 允许哪些字段？遮过的载荷仍可能暴露支付或身份细节。

lines.en: Okay, only generated correlation IDs and attempt numbers. No payloads, authorization headers, or email addresses.
lines.zh: 好，只用生成的关联ID和尝试编号，不放载荷、授权头或邮件地址。

lines.en: Just to confirm, access is restricted, right? These logs aren't public incident attachments.
lines.zh: 确认一下，访问受限，对吧？不是公开事件附件。

lines.en: Yes, with an approved retention policy. Delete temporary records after the review window ends.
lines.zh: 是，有批准保留策略，评审窗口结束后删除临时记录。

lines.en: This should buy us time for linkage checks. Maybe it won't expose every retry path.
lines.zh: 这能为关联检查争取时间，但可能看不到所有重试路径。

lines.en: Correct. Correlation logs don't provide full span timing. Keep their limitations in the handoff.
lines.zh: 对，关联日志不提供完整跨度耗时，交接写明限制。

lines.en: So, keep an eye on log volume too. Disable the temporary flag after acceptance.
lines.zh: 那么，也关注日志量，验收后关闭临时标记。

lines.en: I'll inspect a sample for accidental sensitive fields. Redaction needs a real verification step.
lines.zh: 我检查样本是否混入敏感字段，脱敏需要真正验证。

lines.en: I'll attach the allowed schema, not raw records. Next we need the remaining test matrix.
lines.zh: 我附允许字段结构，不附原始记录，接着列剩余测试矩阵。

dialogues.title: 异步重试不能继承错请求
dialogues.premise: 脱敏日志可辅助检查，明确晚班待测路径。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别并发上下文泄漏与重试关联风险。

lines.en: We still need to verify the async boundary. Include retries, batches, and concurrent consumers.
lines.zh: 仍需验证异步边界，包含重试、批次和并发消费者。

lines.en: A single smoke test isn't enough. Check that one message can't inherit another's context.
lines.zh: 单个快速测试不够，检查一条消息不能继承另一条上下文。

lines.en: Okay, who's picking this up tonight? Just to confirm, staging only for the patch, right?
lines.zh: 好，今晚谁接？确认一下，补丁只测预发布，对吧？

lines.en: My action item is the test matrix. Maybe retries need separate span links, not fake parents.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是测试矩阵，重试可能要独立跨度链接，不要伪造父跨度。

lines.en: I'll own runtime validation tonight. The approved tracing model decides parents versus links.
lines.zh: 今晚运行时验证我负责，批准追踪模型决定父关系或链接。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis concerns creation order. We shouldn't rewrite the whole tracing model tonight.
lines.zh: 当前假设针对创建顺序，今晚不重写整套追踪模型。

lines.en: Also test context cleanup after processing. Leaked active context can join unrelated requests.
lines.zh: 也测处理后上下文清理，泄漏活动上下文会串联无关请求。

lines.en: So, attach outcomes to each test row. Unknown results stay open at shift end.
lines.zh: 那么，每条测试附结果，换班结束时未知结果仍保持未完成。

lines.en: I'll report failures before approving the patch. No production deployment from a passing single example.
lines.zh: 批准补丁前报告失败，不能凭一个成功例子部署生产。

lines.en: I'll leave the version and exact commands. The next question is metadata safety.
lines.zh: 我留下版本与准确命令，接下来确认元数据安全。

dialogues.title: 追踪头不是敏感字段通行证
dialogues.premise: 晚班接受测试矩阵，追问传播字段和安全边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分traceparent与baggage，并听清不可信边界。

lines.en: What about the baggage allowlist? Traceparent and arbitrary baggage aren't the same thing.
lines.zh: 附加字段允许清单呢？traceparent与任意baggage不是同一件事。

lines.en: Okay, baggage is empty for this flow. We don't propagate customer identifiers or tokens.
lines.zh: 好，这条流程的baggage为空，不传播客户标识或令牌。

lines.en: Just to confirm, incoming headers are validated, right? External context isn't automatically trusted.
lines.zh: 确认一下，入口头会校验，对吧？外部上下文不是自动可信。

lines.en: Yes, the gateway enforces format and size. Malformed context mustn't break business processing.
lines.zh: 是，网关限制格式和大小，坏上下文不能破坏业务处理。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Trace identifiers travel; sensitive baggage doesn't. Maybe document both limits.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，追踪标识传递，敏感附加字段不传，也许两类限制都记。

lines.en: And context isn't authorization. Never use a trace identifier to grant access or prove identity.
lines.zh: 上下文不是授权，绝不靠追踪标识授予访问或证明身份。

lines.en: The retention policy covers correlation records too. Access stays with the investigation group.
lines.zh: 保留策略也覆盖关联记录，访问限调查组。

lines.en: So, use the security escalation path for leaks. Have I missed anything about tonight's tests?
lines.zh: 那么，泄漏走安全升级路径，今晚测试还有遗漏吗？

lines.en: Include invalid headers and oversized baggage. Safety tests belong beside propagation tests.
lines.zh: 包含无效头和超大baggage，安全测试与传播测试放一起。

lines.en: I'll add those rows before signing off. No sensitive values in the test fixtures.
lines.zh: 离班前补这些行，测试数据不含敏感值。

dialogues.title: 晚班何时找人
dialogues.premise: 安全及传播测试清单确认，约定联系时点和业务故障处理。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分追踪未修复和业务异常的升级速度。

lines.en: Unresolved trace linkage goes to tomorrow's review. Business failures still need immediate incident response.
lines.zh: 未解决追踪关联进入明日评审，业务失败仍需立即事件响应。

lines.en: Who owns that escalation path tonight? I need a named contact, not a team label.
lines.zh: 今晚谁负责升级路径？需要具名联系人，不是团队名字。

lines.en: Okay, I'm the backup until midnight. Anika owns consumer questions during the review window.
lines.zh: 好，午夜前我是后备，评审窗口内Anika负责消费者问题。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Lukas is primary on-call, right? Page the backup after five silent minutes.
lines.zh: 确认一下，Lukas是第一响应值班人，对吧？五分钟无回应呼叫后备。

lines.en: After midnight, use the posted rota contact. Don't rely on an outgoing engineer staying awake.
lines.zh: 午夜后用已发布轮班联系人，不依赖离班工程师不睡觉。

lines.en: Maybe staging reveals a broader context leak. Pause the patch and call me before proceeding.
lines.zh: 预发布可能发现更广上下文泄漏，暂停补丁，继续前找我。

lines.en: What's the ETA for tomorrow's review? I'll send evidence before that, including failed tests.
lines.zh: 明日评审预计几点？之前我发送证据，也包含失败测试。

lines.en: So, nine thirty tomorrow with the reviewers. No deadline pressure overrides the acceptance gates.
lines.zh: 那么，明日九点半与评审人开会，期限压力不凌驾验收关口。

lines.en: Any sensitive-data leak goes to security immediately. That's separate from waiting on trace repair.
lines.zh: 任何敏感数据泄漏立即找安全团队，不能等追踪修复。

lines.en: I'll put the contacts beside each trigger. Then Lukas can confirm the handoff.
lines.zh: 我把联系人放每个触发条件旁，然后Lukas确认交接。

dialogues.title: 接的是验证责任而非已修复
dialogues.premise: 证据、待测矩阵、安全边界与联系人已交付，晚班复述。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住接班确认及尚未完成项。

lines.en: Handoff acceptance means I've received the open tasks. I've got it from here for tonight's validation.
lines.zh: 交接验收指我已收到未完成任务，今晚验证接下来由我负责。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, sampling explains some absences. The sampled test has a separate propagation break.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，采样解释部分缺失，已采样测试另有传播断点。

lines.en: We hand over evidence, not production approval. The patch still needs all safety checks.
lines.zh: 交接的是证据，不是生产批准，补丁仍需所有安全检查。

lines.en: I'll retain the restricted test references. Temporary log access expires after tomorrow's review.
lines.zh: 我保留受限测试引用，临时日志访问明日评审后到期。

lines.en: Maybe retry tests change our patch choice. Call me if the proposed order fails.
lines.zh: 重试测试可能改变补丁选择，提议顺序失败就找我。

lines.en: I'll report staging results at nine thirty. No production fix is claimed tonight.
lines.zh: 我九点半报告预发布结果，今晚不宣称生产已修复。

lines.en: Have I missed anything in the contacts? You have backup coverage after midnight, right?
lines.zh: 联系人有遗漏吗？午夜后有后备覆盖，对吧？

lines.en: So, the posted rota covers that shift. Business and security triggers remain immediate.
lines.zh: 那么，发布轮班表覆盖该班，业务与安全触发仍立即处理。

lines.en: Acceptance evidence needs timestamps and versions. Passing tests aren't enough without knowing what ran.
lines.zh: 验收证据需时间戳和版本，不知道跑了什么就不能只看通过。

lines.en: We'll close the loop after reviewed validation. Thanks, I'll leave the consumer notes ready.
lines.zh: 评审验证后反馈闭环，谢谢，我会备好消费者记录。
